preconditions.description: The lengths n, m, and parameter k satisfy the given constraints.
The strings s and t have lengths n and m respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'No' on a single line, or 'Yes' followed by a second line with two integers.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'No' or (1 <= L <= n - k + 1 and 1 <= R <= n - k + 1 and L + k <= R)
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'Yes', the indices L and R are valid 1-based start positions for non-intersecting substrings of length k in s.
If the answer is 'Yes', the concatenation of the two substrings starting at L and R contains t as a substring.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'No' or not any((1 <= l <= n - k + 1 and 1 <= r <= n - k + 1 and l + k <= r and t in s[l-1:l-1+k] + s[r-1:r-1+k]) for l in range(1, n - k + 2) for r in range(l + k, n - k + 2))
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'No', no pair of non-intersecting substrings of length k from s can be concatenated to form a string containing t.
